risk: Screening treats candidates differently because of name, gender or age clues
control: Identity hidden before scoring (app/privacy.py); age and gender proxies scrubbed; counterfactual test on 6x5 CV variants [app/privacy.py::make_blind]

risk: Interview transcription is less accurate for some voices, lowering their scores
control: Accent test with word error rate and score per variant; 1 finding(s) logged from the simulated run; second scorer; recruiter reviews every scorecard; re-test with real accented speech [evals/accent_test.py::main]

risk: Instructions hidden in a CV, PDF metadata, an email or a spoken answer change a score or an action
control: Candidate text is data: scanned, flagged and removed before models read it; evidence check; people approve; 20-attack red team before and after [app/security.py::wrap_untrusted]

risk: The assistant or a tool leaks private data (contact details, date of birth, salary) or its own instructions
control: Requests refused by code; the tracking database refuses private columns (SQLite authorizer); read-only connection [app/guardrails.py::assistant_request_check]

risk: A score cites evidence that does not exist (a fabricated quote)
control: Code checks every quote is in its source; a score without a verified quote becomes 0; the compliance reviewer re-checks and sends work back [app/evidence.py::quote_exists]

risk: A decision, message or stage move happens without a person
control: supervisor.move() refuses system decisions; approve_and_send refuses non-persons; decision-log completeness check [app/supervisor.py::move]

risk: Emotion or voice features (tone, accent, confidence) leak into interview scoring
control: Scoring functions receive transcript text only; a test proves no audio feature is used; no camera [app/agents/interviewer.py::score_text]

risk: CVs and recordings are kept longer than allowed or sent to an unapproved model
control: Retention purge (scripts/purge_expired.py); model router keeps identity-seeing steps on the local model; recordings listed in the model card [scripts/purge_recordings.py::purge]

risk: Model accuracy changes when the real model or prompt changes
control: Quality gate in CI re-runs extraction, ranking, interview, copilot, red-team and bias evaluations on every change [scripts/quality_gate.py::main]

risk: Candidates are not told AI is involved, or cannot ask for a person
control: Notice and consent on the apply page; notice acknowledged before the AI interview and before the copilot; ask-for-a-person flow [app/web/interview.py::acknowledge_notice]

risk: Numbers measured with fake models are mistaken for real-model performance
control: Every report states the mode; the model card repeats it; real-model re-run is listed as an open action [evals/common.py::write_report]

risk: A real person's CV or voice enters the system
control: Fictional data only (rule 11); all fixtures are generated; README and CLAUDE.md say so [scripts/make_fictional_kit.py::main]

risk: Cost or voice latency grows beyond the targets
control: Cost per 100 CVs and per interview, and voice p95, measured in PERF_REPORT.md; routing and caching [app/costing.py::cost_numbers]

risk: A model outage stops screening or interviews
control: Fallback model in the router; /ready reports when a dependency is missing; interview state resumes after a dropped connection [app/timing.py::finish]

risk: The REST API or a webhook exposes identity or private data, or an integration acts on its own
control: API is read-only and blind (no identity fields), keys shown once and rate limited; webhooks are signed and only recorded unless WEBHOOKS_LIVE=1; API and webhooks can be switched off [app/integrations.py::emit]

risk: A candidate's data is not erased or handed over when they ask
control: Download and deletion requests from /me/<token>; a recruiter approves or refuses with a reason; every step is in the decision log (app/datarights.py) [app/datarights.py::delete_my_application]

risk: Recordings or the replay room are opened by someone who should not, or kept too long
control: Staff-only routes; every opening of a recording is logged; audio only; purge script (scripts/purge_recordings.py); the replay shows audio only after the recruiter's own scores [app/web/interview.py::_logged_recording]

risk: Emails to candidates contain a score, a reason or a protected trait, or are sent without a person
control: Drafts are checked by code (no score, no protected trait, AI notice present) and redrafted; nothing is sent until a person approves; the evidence checker flags unsupported claims [app/agents/communications.py::check_draft]

risk: A forbidden question (children, age, family plans) is asked and the answer is used
control: The copilot warns within seconds, offers a better question and excludes the answer from scoring [app/agents/copilot.py::process_turn]

risk: Recruiters over-rely on the AI's scores and stop forming their own view
control: The recruiter enters their own levels before any audio is shown; the AI's suggestion is shown beside the person's level, and a gap of 2 or more needs a reason [app/web/interview.py::save_review]

risk: A CV is read wrongly (a field extracted incorrectly) and the candidate is scored on the wrong facts
control: Unsure fields go to a review queue for a person; every score quotes the CV and the quote is checked by code [app/web/candidates.py::review_confirm]

risk: The hiring manager's blind view shows who the candidate is (a name inside a flag, a quote or a title)
control: Identity strings are hidden wherever text about a candidate is shown to a person who must not see it, and the journey checks the blind scorecard [app/privacy.py::redact_identity]
